# 24HR Locksmith San Diego
> Local 24-hour mobile locksmith serving all of San Diego County. Licensed and insured. 20-30 minute response time. Call (619) 625-3279 any time.

## Services
- [Emergency Locksmith](https://24hrlocksmithsandiego.com/emergency-locksmith) — 24/7 emergency lockouts, broken keys, post-break-in lock replacement
- [Residential Locksmith](https://24hrlocksmithsandiego.com/residential-locksmith) — home lockouts, rekeying, deadbolt installation, smart locks
- [Commercial Locksmith](https://24hrlocksmithsandiego.com/commercial-locksmith) — office lockouts, master key systems, access control, rekeying after staff changes
- [Automotive Locksmith](https://24hrlocksmithsandiego.com/automotive-locksmith) — car key programming, ignition repair, all makes and models
- [Car Lockout](https://24hrlocksmithsandiego.com/car-lockout) — locked keys in car, slim jim, no tow required
- [Car Key Replacement](https://24hrlocksmithsandiego.com/car-key-replacement) — transponder keys, key fobs, push-to-start, on-site cutting and programming

## Service Area
San Diego County — La Jolla, Chula Vista, El Cajon, Carlsbad, Oceanside, Escondido, Downtown San Diego, Pacific Beach, North Park, Mission Valley, Gaslamp Quarter, Mission Hills, Hillcrest, National City, La Mesa, Santee, Lemon Grove, Poway, San Marcos, Encinitas.
